name: SajanGaba/zacks_scraper
what_it_holds: Python scraper (R3.py) for Zacks Investment Research plus one committed snapshot file R300.csv covering Russell 3000-style universe; ~14 fields per company including forward sales/earnings estimates, PE/PEG, and earnings-surprise history. Single point-in-time snapshot, not a repeated vintage series; no date metadata confirmed on the file itself.
why_useful: Closest thing found to a free, machine-pullable Zacks consensus-estimate scraper with a working example output; could be re-run at guide dates going forward to start building a point-in-time consensus series for ABNB per rule #2 (gap #4), though it captures no ABNB history retroactively.
time_coverage: single scrape snapshot, no historical run confirmed
size_hint: one CSV (R300.csv), unknown row count, small repo
themes: Analyst estimates and consensus history: Yahoo/Zacks/Finviz/Estimize/Alpha Vantage scrapers, historical EPS estimate datasets, estimate-revision datasets, I/B/E/S-like open data

name: QuantConnect/Lean.DataSource.Estimize
what_it_holds: C# reference implementation (DataProcessing/, EstimizeConsensus.cs, EstimizeEstimate.cs, EstimizeRelease.cs) showing how QuantConnect's Lean platform ingests Estimize's Estimates/Releases/Consensus data types. No underlying Estimize data is committed to the repo — it is a schema/pipeline example only, and the actual Estimize feed is a paid QuantConnect Data Marketplace product.
why_useful: Documents the exact schema (per-company consensus, individual crowd estimates, releases) an I/B/E/S-like Estimize feed would have if the team later pays for or otherwise obtains Estimize data; not itself a free data source.
themes: Analyst estimates and consensus history: Yahoo/Zacks/Finviz/Estimize/Alpha Vantage scrapers, historical EPS estimate datasets, estimate-revision datasets, I/B/E/S-like open data
Event-study and factor packages; earnings-surprise datasets; post-earnings-drift replication; Ken French factor loaders
why_all: Documents the exact schema (per-company consensus, individual crowd estimates, releases) an I/B/E/S-like Estimize feed would have if the team later pays for or otherwise obtains Estimize data; not itself a free data source.

Estimize crowd estimates are an independent, higher-frequency-updating consensus series distinct from IBES/vendor consensus -- could give a point-in-time crowd-consensus check for ABNB revenue/EPS ahead of the 5 Nov print (gap #4, point-in-time consensus).

name: Finnhub-Stock-API/finnhub-python
what_it_holds: Official Python client (1074 stars, Apache-2.0) for the Finnhub API, which offers (per free tier, rate-limited) institutional ownership, insider transactions, ETF holdings/country/sector exposure, and short-interest-adjacent fundamentals endpoints alongside real-time price data. No data committed — a general API client; usefulness is gated on Finnhub's free-tier limits for these specific endpoints (untested here).
why_useful: One client could in principle pull ABNB institutional-ownership history, insider transactions, and ETF-holdings country/sector breakdowns without separately licensed data, if the free tier actually exposes historical (not just current) values — worth a human check of Finnhub's free-tier scope before relying on it.
time_coverage: depends on Finnhub API entitlement, unconfirmed
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: One client could in principle pull ABNB institutional-ownership history, insider transactions, and ETF-holdings country/sector breakdowns without separately licensed data, if the free tier actually exposes historical (not just current) values — worth a human check of Finnhub's free-tier scope before relying on it.

name: 13f-portfolio-analysis
what_it_holds: Reconstructs institutional portfolios from raw SEC EDGAR 13F filings: idempotent ingestion, per-filing value-unit verification, multi-strategy CUSIP resolution (claims 99.68% resolved by value), amendment-aware quarter-over-quarter diffs, Streamlit dashboard where every number traces back to its EDGAR accession number. Updated 2026-09-08 (very recent).
why_useful: More rigorous 13F pipeline than the toy scrapers -- CUSIP resolution and amendment handling matter for building a clean institutional-ownership-concentration time series for ABNB or its holders/comps; addresses gap #15.
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: More rigorous 13F pipeline than the toy scrapers -- CUSIP resolution and amendment handling matter for building a clean institutional-ownership-concentration time series for ABNB or its holders/comps; addresses gap #15.

name: alphasmo-tools

why_useful: Combines 13F and Form 4 access with a convergence-signal layer already built; could be repurposed to watch ABNB institutional/insider activity around print dates without building the plumbing.
